title: Data import
subtitle: Upload an xlsx file to import business data asynchronously. Pick an import type, then upload; after parsing you can preview and confirm.

split.heading: Academic-affairs schedule splitter
split.subtitle: Upload the aggregated schedule exported by the academic-affairs office (classrooms / courses / admin classes / teachers / weeks), fill in the semester and the Monday of week 1, and the system splits it into 6 import jobs (classrooms / course catalog / admin classes / teaching classes / offerings / sessions) and opens a step-by-step wizard to preview and confirm in dependency order: classrooms → catalog → admin classes → teaching classes → offerings → sessions. Offerings and sessions reference the catalog and teaching classes; the wizard refreshes each step's preview on entry, so before its prerequisites are committed the preview reports “does not exist”, and re-validates after — no re-split needed.
split.successSubtitle: Classrooms {{classrooms}} · Courses {{catalogCourses}} · Admin classes {{adminClasses}} · Teaching classes {{teachingClasses}} · Offerings {{offerings}} · Sessions {{sessions}} (skipped empty admin {{skippedEmptyAdmin}} / parallel {{skippedParallel}} / no-teacher filled {{noTeacherFilled}})

wizard.heading: Academic-affairs split · step-by-step
wizard.timeout: Processing timed out; check the job status in the list.
wizard.skippedNote: Skipped: not committed, can be handled individually in the job list. Downstream steps may fail because the dependency is missing.
wizard.failedNote: Commit failed; you can retry or skip.
wizard.doneSubtitle: Review each job's final result in the Data import list.

sessions.label: Schedule (sessions)
sessions.note: Classrooms and offerings must be created first, referenced by name; deduplicated by classroom + date + period range, conflicting rows skipped. period_end is optional, defaulting to period_start (a multi-period block such as 3-4 is one session).

classrooms.label: Classrooms
classrooms.note: Upsert by classroom name: update if exists, otherwise insert. floor/campus are optional floor and campus fields.

teaching_classes.label: Teaching classes
teaching_classes.note: Parent-child table flattened: one row per member admin class, grouped by name. Members of a teaching class referenced by an offering cannot be modified.

catalog.label: Course catalog
catalog.note: Upsert by course name. code has a unique index (blank stored as NULL, mutually non-conflicting); credits/total_hours/category/exam_type are optional academic-affairs attributes.

offerings.label: Offerings
offerings.note: Upsert by course + teaching class + semester; course and teaching class referenced by name, must be created first. course_seq..weekly_hours are optional academic-affairs offering metadata.

regimes.label: Schedule regimes
regimes.note: Parent-child table flattened: one row per period, grouped by regime_name; on commit the regime's periods are replaced as a whole.

bookings.label: Classroom bookings
bookings.note: Recovery mode: restored by the status in the file. pending/approved rows occupy the period and run conflict checks.
